name: localmind
title: Localmind
description: Execute quick, one-off queries to your local Ollama instance directly from Raycast without a bulky chat UI or conversation history.
author: gigarthan

preferences.name: ollamaHost
preferences.title: Ollama Host
preferences.description: The URL of your Ollama instance (default: http://localhost:11434)

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: The default model to use for queries

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
